The '''Hammer''' was a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] that was operated by [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Thorn/Legends|Thorn]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It doubled as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]], as demonstrated by Thorn on Scipio. Though he fought fiercely and took down many droids, he was finally overwhelmed by droids, and he was shot to death in the chest.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hammer was created by [[Dave Filoni]] and the story team of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' as an homage to [[Wikipedia:Mjolnir|Mjolnir]], the Hammer weapon wielded by [[Wikipedia:Thor|Thor]] in [[Marvel Comics]]' movie [[Wikipedia:The Avengers (2012 film)|''The Avengers'']]. The Hammer was stated to be introduced in ''[[The Clone Wars: Season Five]]'', but was moved to [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Clone Wars'': The Lost Missions]] alongside the episode it was set to debut in, "[[Crisis at the Heart]]."
